title: The quarter, on the phone
direction: A×C · Round 11 · GTM Intelligence head, redrawn for the phone (1440 and tablet as approved in round 10)
summary: The approved quarter (one quarter laid down week by week, gathered into one red page that sets next quarter), with its phone frame redrawn instead of shrunk: time runs down the screen a week to a row, the three activities are three named columns that run into the red page, and the page forks into next quarter (the checks and calls carried on, the contact list stopped, a branch to the new column); every word at real size (16px names, 13px week numbers) from 320 to 767.

reference.site: The approved homepage method (method/U), handover/U and system/T
reference.borrowed: A real calendar span to scale; one solid subject (the red page, written like system/T's red slab); the strike of an old line (handover); a bar that runs off the plate (method).
reference.kelwin: The quarter itself is the object and the motion is the verb: weeks lay down, the gather reads them into a written page, the page sets next quarter. The headline's claim, the loop that learns, is drawn as the difference between two quarters.

motion: 1440 and tablet: round 10's, unchanged (see r10-intel/S.meta.json): start at the h1's last letter − 250ms once 40% of the plate is on screen; weeks at 175ms; the gather; the red page; next quarter once on screen. Settled 5.1s (1440) / 6.1s (tablet).

phone, beat 1 (.is-lay, once the names are 60% on screen): the three names write in 160ms apart, each flag's rule draws out to its column (450ms) and down; then the quarter's measure: the extension lines from week 1 and week 13 (450ms at 800ms), the dimension between them (1000ms), 'This quarter, 13 weeks' (1300ms). The weeks wait (.is-wait).

phone, beat 2 (.is-run, once 92% of the 13 weeks are on screen, or 60% of the screen): the three columns draw down (450ms); a playhead walks down the weeks at 175ms a week, each week's hairline, number and marks landing as it passes (a check every week, grey; a call on weeks 2, 4, 5, 8, 10, 12; a hollow square every week); at 2475ms the gather: a 2px wire runs down each column, under the marks, into the page (800ms, linear), lighting every check and the four calls that named the security review; the red page grows down from where the wires meet it (3325ms, 500ms) and writes itself; its name.

phone, beat 3 (.is-run2, at 4375ms and once three quarters of next quarter's weeks are on screen): the page forks into next quarter. Its weeks and the open dimension 'Next quarter' come in; the checks and calls carry on down out of the page (450ms) with arrowheads into week 1; the contact list comes out of the page and stops on a bar, its rule draws out to 'Stopped: 0 replies in 13 weeks' and its name at the top is struck (650ms); a branch leaves the page's foot between the calls and the list, passes under the stop and drops, with the same arrowhead, onto the head of the new column (150–930ms); 'New: a one-page security answer' and its rule; the solid column grows from week 1 off the plate (600ms at 850ms). Settled about 1.45s after beat 3 starts. Nothing loops.

interaction: Replay (the band) runs the weeks again from week 1 (the names stay); on a phone, if the weeks are not on screen it first scrolls them back (the names above them where the screen allows) and plays them once the scroll has settled.
reduced motion / no script: the finished frame at every width, no playhead, no Replay.
notes: Round 11 (the founder: 'very cramped and very off-looking in the phone views'). The 1440 and tablet frames are pixel-identical to r10-intel/S. The phone frame is HTML (qa/r11/look/intel/tools/gen-phone.mjs writes its markup; decorative boxes are empty spans), switched in by visibility and a collapsed box, never display: none, so a frame mid-animation keeps its clock. Its column step grows with the phone (34, 40, 48, 56px at 320, 360, 390, 430) and the drawing stops at 456px, centred with its caption from 488 to 767. Illustrative, said once in the head's label row (Specimen quarter): the weeks of the calls, which four named security, the 0 replies.
